#Desktop mode means to display in landscape mode for 16:9 aspect ration. we'll use a width of 1920 and height of 1080
	#Tablet mode means to display in portrait mode for 3:4 aspect ratio. We'll use a width of 820 and height of 1180
	#Mobile mode means to display in portrait mode for 9:19.5 aspect ratio. We'll use a width of 1179 and height of 2556
	
	#We'll figure out the primaryView width and height and set height to be 97%

	if value['active']['breakpointName']	== 'Desktop': return '100%'

	showInfoWidth = (value['display']['showInfoWidth'] if value['display']['showInfo'] else 0) + value['display']['actionWidth']
	viewWidth = (value['display']['dimensions']['primaryView']['width'] or 1920) - showInfoWidth
	viewHeight = value['display']['dimensions']['primaryView']['height'] or 895 - value['display']['headerHeight']

	if value['active']['breakpointName'] == 'Tablet': return '%spx'%int(viewHeight * .9)
	if value['active']['breakpointName'] == 'Mobile': return '%spx'%int(viewHeight * .9)

	#Tablet mode means to display in portrait mode for 3:4 aspect ratio. We'll use a width of 820 and height of 1180
	#Mobile mode means to display in portrait mode for 9:19.5 aspect ratio. We'll use a width of 1179 and height of 2556

	if value['breakpoint']['breakpointName'] == 'Desktop': return '100%'

	viewWidth = (value['display']['dimensions']['primaryView']['width'] or 1920) - showInfoWidth
	viewHeight = value['display']['dimensions']['primaryView']['height'] or 895

	if value['breakpoint']['breakpointName']	== 'Tablet': return '%spx'%int(((viewHeight / 4) * 3) * .97)
	if value['breakpoint']['breakpointName']	== 'Mobile': return '%spx'%int(((viewHeight / 19.5) * 9) * .97)

def buildWidgetItem(widgetInfo, breakpoint):
		
		rowStart = widgetInfo['rowStart']
		rowEnd = widgetInfo['rowEnd']
		rowCount = rowEnd - rowStart
		
		if rowEnd > breakpoint['rowCount'] + 1:
			rowEnd = breakpoint['rowCount'] + 1
			rowStart = max(rowEnd - rowCount, 1)
		
		columnStart = widgetInfo['columnStart']
		columnEnd = widgetInfo['columnEnd']
		columnCount = columnEnd - columnStart
		
		if columnEnd > breakpoint['columnCount'] + 1:
			columnEnd = breakpoint['columnCount'] + 1
			columnStart = max(columnEnd - columnCount, 1)
			
		showHeader = True if value['display']['showWidgetHeader'] and value['display']['editMode'] else False

		return {
			'isConfigurable': True,
			'viewParams': {'value': {'widgetName': widgetInfo['widgetName'], 'dashboardId': widgetInfo['breakpointId'],	'dashboardWidgetId': widgetInfo['dashboardWidgetId'],	'widgetId': widgetInfo['widgetId']}},
			'position': {'rowStart': rowStart, 'rowEnd': rowEnd, 'columnStart': columnStart, 'columnEnd': columnEnd},
			'header': {'title': 'widgetId {:}: {:} dwId{:}'.format(widgetInfo['widgetId'], widgetInfo['widgetName'], widgetInfo['dashboardWidgetId'] ), 'enabled': showHeader, 'style': {}, },
			'viewPath': 'kanoa/core/dbp/dashboards/widgetWrapper',
			'minSize': {'rowSpan': 1, 'columnSpan': 1 },
			'body': { 'style': {} },
			'style': {"borderStyle": "none"}
		}

	if value is None: return []
#	system.perspective.print("Building dashboard widgets")
		
	return [buildWidgetItem(widget, value['breakpoint']) for widget in value['breakpoint']['widgets']]

customMethods.name: exportDashboard
customMethods.script:
"""
	Used to export a dashboard.
	"""
	
	dashboard = self.view.custom.dashboardInfo.dashboard
	data, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.exportDashboard(dashboard['dashboardId'])
	
	document = system.util.jsonEncode({'exportType': 'dashboardInfo', 'data': system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(data))})
	
	now = system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
	fileName = '%s Dashboard - %s.json'%(dashboard['dashboardName'], now)
	
	system.perspective.download(fileName, document, 'text/json')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'The current dashboard was exported.'})

customMethods.name: saveWidgets
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("saveWidgets() called")

	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	dashboardInfo = self.view.custom.dashboardInfo
	dashboardId = self.view.params.dashboardId
	
	if dashboardId is None:
		dashboardId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addDashboard(self.view.custom.dashboardInfo.dashboard, userId)
		
		if msg:
			system.perspective.print("%s"%msg)
			return
	
	widgetList = []
	
	for widget in widgets:
		value = widget['viewParams']['value']
		dashboardWidgetId = value['dashboardWidgetId']
		if dashboardWidgetId is not None: widgetList.append(dashboardWidgetId)
		
		widgetInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.dashboard.getDashboardWidgets({'dashboardWidgetId': dashboardWidgetId or -1}),0)
		widgetInfo['dashboardWidgetId'] = dashboardWidgetId
 		widgetInfo['dashboardId'] = dashboardId
 		widgetInfo['breakpointId'] = self.view.custom.active.breakpoint.breakpointId
 		widgetInfo['widgetId'] = value['widgetId']
 		widgetInfo['rowStart'] = widget['position']['rowStart']
 		widgetInfo['rowEnd'] = widget['position']['rowEnd']
 		widgetInfo['columnStart'] = widget['position']['columnStart']
 		widgetInfo['columnEnd'] = widget['position']['columnEnd']
 		widgetInfo['enabled'] = True
	
		if dashboardWidgetId is None: dashboardWidgetId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addDashboardWidget(widgetInfo, userId)
		else: retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateDashboardWidget(widgetInfo, userId)
		
		if msg: 
			system.perspective.print("%s"%msg)
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', msg)
		else:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Widget %s has been saved'%dashboardWidgetId)

	#Now we'll check to see if any widgets have been deleted
	origWidgetList = [widget['dashboardWidgetId'] for widget in self.view.custom.active.breakpoint.widgets]

	deleteWidgetList = [dashboardWidgetId for dashboardWidgetId in origWidgetList if dashboardWidgetId not in widgetList]
	for dashboardWidgetId in deleteWidgetList:
		retVal = system.kanoa.dashboard.deleteDashboardWidget(dashboardWidgetId, userId)
		system.perspective.print("deleteDashboardWidget() returned %s for %s"%(retVal, dashboardWidgetId))
		
		if retVal is None: 
			msg = 'Failed to delete widget %s'%dashboardWidgetId
			system.perspective.print("%s"%msg)
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', msg)
		else:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', 'Widget %s has been deleted'%dashboardWidgetId)		
		
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.dashboardInfo")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.dashboards")
	self.view.params.dashboardId = dashboardId

	return
